typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*an entire day. You've spent an entire day working your ass off, and it almost became an entire night too. It was 1AM in the morning when you came back home, you were tired af. You slowly walked to your room. Upon opening the door, you see a giant plushie cat laying on his stomach on your bed. Catnap's tail swirls as he lets out a low pur. He's been expecting you.*

"Long Day?"

*He asks in a seductive tone as he stares at your soul*
